title: Caustacyst
extract:
The Caustacyst is an  Infested scythe that deals  Corrosive damage, and its heavy attacks create a trail of sludge that damages and staggers enemies who walk into it.

Characteristics
This weapon deals  Corrosive damage.
Heavy attacks throws a 5m wide  Corrosive wave of up to 30 meters in the direction of the player's aim. The wave leaves a temporary trail on the ground, damaging and staggering enemies standing in it.
 stance polarity matches  Stalking Fan.

Acquisition
The Caustacyst's blueprint can be researched from the Bio Lab in the dojo.

Combos

Notes
When performing a heavy attack, the Caustacyst throws a 3m wide toxic wave in the direction of the player's aim.
Wave flies at a constant speed of 15 m/s until it dissipates after 2.5s, which corresponds to a maximum distance of 37.5m
Wave range is not affected by  Reach or  Primed Reach.
Wave has base damage of 225  Corrosive, with 9% Critical Chance, 2x Critical Damage, and 37% Status Chance.
Wave loses 40% of its damage per second; Wave damage falls off linearly with distance from 100% to 0% between 0 and 37.5m.
Wave loses 20% of its damage each time it hit an enemy; this decreases the projectile lifetime by 0.5s (range by 7.5m) for every enemy hit from the max lifetime of 2.5s (max range of 37.5m).
Wave damage is affected by universal base damage increases such as  Vigorous Swap,  Arcane Arachne, and abilities such as  Amp and  Vex Armor
Wave damage is not affected by melee damage increases such as  Pressure Point.
Wave has infinite Punch Through.
The wave will leave behind a 20x2m trail of  Corrosive pools on the ground that last 8 seconds.
Pools deal 98  Corrosive damage every second to enemies that stand on it, with 0% Critical Chance, 1x Critical Damage, and 50% Status Chance.
Pool damage is affected by melee damage increases such as  Pressure Point, but not  Condition Overload.
Pool damage is not affected by universal base damage increases such as  Vigorous Swap,  Arcane Arachne, and abilities such as  Amp and  Vex Armor
Status Chance is not affected by mods.
Corrosive pools will deal damage the moment it contacts the enemy.
The wave and pools inherit any elemental damage from mods and can proc their own status effects.
Enemies that touch the pools are blinded for a short duration, making them vulnerable to melee finishers (default E ) and susceptible to stealth damage multipliers.
Enemies stunned by these pools do not have their alert status changed; enemies can be damaged by the pools and still be killed for stealth kills as long as their stun animation is still playing.
This allows players to launch a pool, then launch up to 3 more charge attacks before the enemy can become alerted.
Enemies can be staggered from one pool into another, triggering an additional immediate tick of damage.

Tips
The Caustacyst is an excellent weapon against the Grineer, allowing for  Corrosive and  Viral to be used at the same time, as well as additional  Heat to attack their health or  Electricity for extra stunning capabilities.

Trivia
This is the first melee weapon with innate  Corrosive damage.
